scope: reusable support-conserving optical-water reconstruction on an unrelated contemporary construction host

rejectedV2.reason: Depth interpolation and a near-zero depth contour inflated sparse finite-volume puddles into broad contiguous reflective sheets. Volume conservation did not constrain support.

visualEvidence.finding: The large dark contiguous v2 puddle patches are removed. Broad whole-surface gloss remains because the independent receiver film response covers 3595 of 3654 active cells.

publication.reason: The v3 reconstruction mechanics are accepted, but the host is not photographic: near-continuous film response remains too broadly glossy and the facade, glazing, interior and precipitation integration remain simplified.
publication.nextReusableGap: Separate physically plausible thin-film optical response and spatial coverage from conserved puddle optics without weakening the exact surface-water field or tuning a benchmark shot.
